author: CollinRugg
text:
Queer anchor Jana Shortal fumes after Arch Manning laughed about an AI video of coach Steve Sarkisian smacking reporter Holly Rowe.

Shortal says the video is NOT funny and says that protecting "women in sports" means apologizing to Rowe.

"Yeah, real funny!"

Women with this haircut will support a mom who murdered her three children but will get mad about an AI video.
